steps.title: Define App Metadata and Requirements
steps.description: Establish the configuration for Hello App, specifying the application package name com.helloapp.app.

steps.title: Configure Build Steps
steps.description: Initialize the sequential setup and verification tasks within build-steps.json.

steps.title: Configure Root Build Gradle
steps.description: Create the Gradle build script for compiling Hello App with compatible target Android SDK 34.

steps.title: Set Up Android Manifest
steps.description: Define application structures and requirements inside the AndroidManifest.xml, binding the MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout XML
steps.description: Develop a simple layout XML structure placing a central TextView element to display 'hello' to the user.

steps.title: Create MainActivity Java Class
steps.description: Write the MainActivity java file to load the layout and manage the basic lifecycle hooks.

steps.title: Validate Android Namespace and Build Configuration
steps.description: Check the Android XML namespace for standard compatibility and clean the build parameters.

steps.title: Verify Icon Reference
steps.description: Ensure launcher icon parameters inside the AndroidManifest configuration target the correct res drawable source.

steps.title: Perform Java 8 Standard Compatibility Checks
steps.description: Verify code uses anonymous inner classes or standard SDK structures instead of lambdas or modern streams.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Execute final Gradle build tasks to assemble, compile, and output the target debug APK.
